So the data is duplicated (4866 distinct txn_id in 5244 rows), and the fix is to parse both timestamp formats and dedupe by txn_id.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.78, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN make_timestamp(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT) * 1000) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, status, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, txn_ts) = 1) SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
